Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Customer Success Manager - Polish Market (m/f/d) Your role

As Technical Customer Success Manager for the Polish market, you are the primary point of contact for your customer cohort (of SMBs) once they've signed. You own their success, satisfaction, and retention end to end.

You actively build relationships, identify value drivers, and ensure every customer gets the most out of fonio. You'll spend most of your time in calls and meetings with customers and implementing or improving their setups.

What you'll do

 * Own a portfolio of Polish SMB customers across their entire lifecycle with fonio

 * Spend most of your time in calls and meetings with customers - building relationships, surfacing value, and keeping them engaged

 * Run regular check-ins and trigger proactive calls based on usage signals (low engagement, expansion opportunities, setup friction, etc.)

 * Work with a ready-made pipeline and clear playbooks - with room to test your own initiatives and ideas to make them better

 * Maximize the value generated from each customer in your portfolio

 * Support customers in setting up their AI assistant and coordinate appointments with our developers for more complex setups

 * Own the churn within your cohort - spot risks early and act on them

 * Work autonomously in HubSpot to manage your activity

Your profile

 * 2-5 years in Customer Success, Account Management, Forward Deployment Engineer or a technical client-facing SaaS/B2B role

 * Ideally a strong technical understanding - comfortable understanding API documentation and error logs to troubleshoot customer setup issues independently

 ** Experience with tools like n8n, make.com, codex or similar

 * An affinity for tech / AI products is a real plus

 * Native Polish, strong English skills

 * Structured, autonomous, and results-driven

 * You build trust with customers easily - by phone, video, and in person

 * You take initiative, test, iterate - and you don't wait to be told what to do

 * Comfortable with a CRM (ideally HubSpot) and a data-driven approach to customer success

What we offer

 * €47,000-70,000 OTE

 * Equity: you help build it, you should own a piece of it

 * Equipment of your choice

 * A key role in fonio's launch in Poland - real ownership over your customers and how we build CS for the Polish market

 * A 40+ person team that values 100% transparency, direct feedback, and flat hierarchies

 * A product that sells itself and that customers love (4.5 stars on Trustpilot, Google, and OMR)

 * Office in Vienna or Warsaw, onsite, in an ambitious team that wants to do the most exciting work of their careers

Hiring Process

 * 15 min intro call

 * 30 min skill interview

 * 30 min getting to know the country's Go-to-Market manager

 * 20 min culture call with our Founders

jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology. * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications. * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation. * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range. * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems. * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system. * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.Your qualifications: * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field. * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further. * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications. * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous. * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial. * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).
